Tech Mahindra | Cloud Consulting Leader | Bengaluru / Hyderabad, India | ONSITE | Full-Time

We run cloud transformation engagements. app modernization, VMware exits, cloud-native re-platforming, landing zones, CCoE builds. Looking for someone who can lead the practice on both the pre-sales and delivery sides, and who is serious about using agentic AI tooling to change how this work gets done.

Strong fit if you: - Have led complex cloud modernization or migration programs end-to-end. - Have done VMware exit work onto hyperscalars, or re-platforming to cloud-native - Have a software/engineering background. you can go deep with architects and contribute to tooling decisions. you can lead the build out accelerators in this space - Have worked with or built agentic AI frameworks for operational or delivery use cases - Can own pre-sales: workshops, solutioning, RFPs, exec conversations - Have built or scaled a cloud practice, CCoE, or enablement program

Familiarity with FinOps and steady-state cloud optimization is a plus. Certs (AWS Pro SA, GCP PCA, Azure Expert) are added bonus.

Apply: Email your resumes to cprabala<at>techmahindra<dot>com
